newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL blue chips rebound on mainly local buying.
newsitem.headline: KL blue chips rebound on mainly local buying.

text.p: Malaysian blue-chip shares rallied on Wednesday as local institutions entered the market to support banking and finance stocks, analysts and dealers said.
At the midday break, the benchmark Composite Index of 100 large-capitalised stocks jumped 14.90 points, or 1.37 percent, to 1,104.90. The index peaked at 1,108.21 in mid-morning trade.
"Buying is confined mainly to banking stocks, and support is coming mainly from local institutions," said Ramlan Ahmad, senior manager of fund managers Commerce MGI in Kuala Lumpur.
Arab Malaysia Merchant Bank rose 70 cents to 16.60 ringgit, and was among morning's highest gainers.
